dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fq_gaps_do: Let me see. ...You've written a great deal. Your hand is steadier than before.

...This will sound strange. The way you shape your letters is like my mother's notebook.
Just my fancy, I'm sure. Put this in it. It was her bookmark.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fq_gaps_of:
Your book? ...There are pages still empty.
Write down everything you can. The village, and what lies above the sky.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fq_menu:
Help, is it? ...Let me think.
The village's requests are pinned to the message board by the bell.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fq_menu.ga: The blank pages in my book bother me.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fq_menu.pa: Shall I take something to the traveler at the edge of the village?
I lost the bundle you gave me.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fq_menu.sh: I want to know more about the shadow.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fq_parcel_:
My mother's clasp. I wondered for years where it had gone. ...So it was in the shawl's pocket.
You keep it. She was one for looking at the sky, too.
I'll take good care of it.

Lost it, did you? ...Oh, never mind. I'll wrap another.
Don't drop this one.

Oh, good timing. Take this to him, would you? Some dried meat and an old shawl.
People who only look at the sky forget to eat, and forget the cold.
My hands are full right now.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.fq_shadow_:
You saw the shadow twice, then.
...Which way did it come from? No, you needn't say.

The notches on my mother's doorpost all slant the same way. Down from the peaks.
...Only the last one stops halfway. I wonder what she saw that day.

The shadow, is it.
...My mother used to cut a notch into the doorpost with her knife, every time the shadow passed.

Why don't you count them too. Look up on a clear day and stand beneath the shadow.
When you have seen it twice, come and tell me.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.menu.erran: Is there anything I can help with?
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_menu.er: Anything else I can do for you?
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.fq_c_boar:
Ah, that. ...Leave the whale's back alone and the sentinels rise again.
If someone walks the rounds, that's enough. I can't grab the chain myself.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.fq_c_clas: Lost it? ...It was lying by the fire. Be careful.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.fq_c_menu: There was a request in your hand on the board.
I lost the clasp you gave me.
Do you know anything about other titans?
The stone whale lets me ride it now.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.fq_c_parc:
...From the old woman?
(He opens the bundle.) ...A shawl. An old one. And dried meat.

Tell her thank you. ...And this was in the shawl's pocket.
A clasp carved from bone. It isn't mine. Give it back to her.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.fq_c_tide: So it wasn't an island. ...Something like a mountain with a shell on its back.

Once at dawn and once at dusk, as the tide ebbs. ...The whale in the sky, that thing in the sea, both keeping time.
As if someone told them to. As if they were waiting for something.
I heard a strange tale by the sea. An island offshore drifts in to the coast, morning and evening, when the tide goes out.

I'm no good with the sea. ...Would you see for yourself?
Wait by the shore when the tide goes out, and watch what comes in. Three times.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.fq_c_way_: It swam across a sea of clouds.
The villages looked like grains of sand.

...I'll likely never go there. But your words let me see a little of it.
Here, for your trouble. A stone I used to mark my way. I don't need it anymore.

...It lets you ride it?
Then I have a favor to ask. Tell me what the land looks like from up there.

Fly somewhere far and come down. Twice. Then come back and tell me.
They say raising a titan waymark gives it more places to go.

A sea of clouds...
From below, the clouds are a ceiling. From above, they become a sea.

Grains of sand. ...I suppose so.
That must be how we look to whoever is up there.
gui.skyabyss.board.footer: To hand in goods, open the board holding them.
gui.skyabyss.board.title: Message Board
item.skyabyss.keepsake.clasp_return: A Clasp from the Shawl's Pocket
item.skyabyss.keepsake.clasp_return.lore: From the whale chaser, for the storyteller.
item.skyabyss.keepsake.indigo_bookmark.l: Embroidered in fine stitches. The storyteller's mother used it.
item.skyabyss.keepsake.notched_stone.lor: A stone the whale chaser used to mark his way. One notch is cut deeper than the rest.
item.skyabyss.keepsake.parcel.lore: Dried meat and an old shawl, for the whale chaser.
item.skyabyss.keepsake.whalebone_clasp.l: It once held the shawl of the storyteller's mother. Carved in the shape of a small whale.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.tide_hours.body:
At dawn and at dusk, as the tide begins to ebb, the offshore island drifts to the coast. I watched three times; three times it came at the same hour.

On the rim of its shell, an old gate rose out of the water.

It does not move until the hour has passed, as if waiting for something.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.tide_hours.title: The Hour of Low Tide
lore.skyabyss.prologue.shadow_heading.bo:
Fine notches line the doorpost of the storyteller's house. Her mother cut one with a knife each time the shadow passed.

Every notch slants the same way, coming down from the direction of the peaks.

Only the last one stops halfway.
message.skyabyss.board.handed: Handed in the items for "%s" at the board.
quest.skyabyss.daily_bone_sentry.done: The sentinels will stay down for a while.
A note on the board, in an angular, unfamiliar hand: "The bone sentinels on the whale's back are rising again. Put eight of them to rest. —The whale chaser"
Defeat bone sentinels on the stone whale's back
quest.skyabyss.daily_bone_sentry.summary: Put eight bone sentinels to rest on the stone whale's back. Party members count too.
quest.skyabyss.daily_bone_sentry.title: Sentinel Rounds
quest.skyabyss.daily_firewood.done: The hearth fire will not go out tonight.
quest.skyabyss.daily_firewood.summary: Hand in sixteen logs at the message board.
quest.skyabyss.daily_firewood.title: Firewood for the Hearth
quest.skyabyss.daily_firewood.wood.journ:
A note on the board: "We're short of firewood. Sixteen logs, please, left at this board. On the seventh night the fire must not go out."
Opening the board with the logs in hand will hand them over.
quest.skyabyss.daily_firewood.wood.wood: Hand in logs at the message board
quest.skyabyss.daily_lost_flock.done: The sheep graze calmly by the board.
quest.skyabyss.daily_lost_flock.herd.her: Lead sheep to within 10 blocks of the message board
quest.skyabyss.daily_lost_flock.herd.jou:
A note on the board: "Three sheep got over the fence. Please bring them back to this board before dark. In a shadow year the sheep are restless."
If I carry wheat, they should follow.
quest.skyabyss.daily_lost_flock.summary: Bring three sheep that strayed from the pen back to the board.
quest.skyabyss.daily_lost_flock.title: Sheep Before Nightfall
quest.skyabyss.daily_night_watch.done: Tonight, the village can sleep in peace.
quest.skyabyss.daily_night_watch.summary: Defeat six night prowlers around the village. Party members count too.
quest.skyabyss.daily_night_watch.title: Night Watch
quest.skyabyss.daily_night_watch.watch.j: A note on the board: "More things prowl around the village at night. On the seventh night we bar the doors, but on other nights someone must keep watch."
quest.skyabyss.sub_lore_gaps.chapter1.jo:
There must be inscriptions I haven't read and pages I haven't found on the stone whale's back.
And there are things to write about the titan of the sea.
quest.skyabyss.sub_lore_gaps.chapter1.lo: Record eleven entries in chapter one of the Book of Lore
quest.skyabyss.sub_lore_gaps.done: She says my handwriting resembles her mother's notebook.
quest.skyabyss.sub_lore_gaps.prologue.jo:
The prologue still has blank pages: the village's old sayings, the shadow in the sky.
The storyteller, the village chests, and the sky itself know the rest.
quest.skyabyss.sub_lore_gaps.prologue.lo: Complete the prologue of the Book of Lore
quest.skyabyss.sub_lore_gaps.summary: Fill in the prologue and chapter one of the Book of Lore, then show the storyteller.
quest.skyabyss.sub_lore_gaps.tell.journa:
I have written down almost everything I can.
I'll show the storyteller.
quest.skyabyss.sub_lore_gaps.tell.talk: Show the book to the storyteller
quest.skyabyss.sub_lore_gaps.title: Filling the Blank Pages
quest.skyabyss.sub_parcel.deliver.give: Deliver the bundle to the whale chaser
quest.skyabyss.sub_parcel.deliver.journa:
The storyteller gave me a bundle for the whale chaser: dried meat and an old shawl.
I'll take it to his fire at the edge of the village.
quest.skyabyss.sub_parcel.done: The clasp was carved in the shape of a small whale.
quest.skyabyss.sub_parcel.return.give: Return the clasp to the storyteller
quest.skyabyss.sub_parcel.return.journal:
A bone clasp was tucked in the shawl's pocket. The whale chaser says it isn't his.
I'll return it to the storyteller.
quest.skyabyss.sub_parcel.summary: Take the storyteller's bundle to the whale chaser, and bring back what he sends.
quest.skyabyss.sub_parcel.title: To the Fireside
quest.skyabyss.sub_shadow_log.done: The last notch on the doorpost stops halfway.
quest.skyabyss.sub_shadow_log.summary: Watch the shadow pass overhead twice, then tell the storyteller.
quest.skyabyss.sub_shadow_log.tell.journ:
I have seen the shadow twice.
I should tell the storyteller.
quest.skyabyss.sub_shadow_log.tell.talk: Tell the storyteller about the shadow
quest.skyabyss.sub_shadow_log.title: The Shadow Tally
quest.skyabyss.sub_shadow_log.watch.jour:
The storyteller's mother cut a notch into her doorpost each time the shadow passed.
On clear days I will look up, stand beneath it, and count.
quest.skyabyss.sub_shadow_log.watch.see: Watch the sky shadow pass overhead
quest.skyabyss.sub_tide_watch.done: Once at dawn, once at dusk, as the tide ebbs. As if waiting for something.
quest.skyabyss.sub_tide_watch.summary: Watch what comes to the shore at low tide three times, then tell the whale chaser.
quest.skyabyss.sub_tide_watch.tell.journ:
All three times, it came at the same hour.
I'll tell the whale chaser.
quest.skyabyss.sub_tide_watch.tell.talk: Tell the whale chaser about the low tides
quest.skyabyss.sub_tide_watch.title: Counting the Low Tides
quest.skyabyss.sub_tide_watch.watch.jour:
They say an island drifts to the shore at dawn and dusk, when the tide goes out.
I'll wait by the sea at low tide and watch it up close. Three times.
quest.skyabyss.sub_tide_watch.watch.watc: Watch what comes ashore at low tide, up close
quest.skyabyss.sub_waymarks.done: The whale chaser gave me his notched stone. He says he no longer needs it.
quest.skyabyss.sub_waymarks.ride.journal:
The whale chaser wants to hear about the land seen from above.
Blow the call whistle and the stone whale's young will come for you. Travel to two destinations on the sky chart. Titan waymarks add more. (Whistle travel goes from ground to ground; it never enters the maze on the back.)
quest.skyabyss.sub_waymarks.summary: Travel twice on the stone whale and tell the whale chaser what the land looks like from above.
quest.skyabyss.sub_waymarks.tell.journal:
I have seen the land from the whale's back twice.
I'll go and tell the whale chaser.
quest.skyabyss.sub_waymarks.tell.talk: Tell the whale chaser about your travels
quest.skyabyss.sub_waymarks.title: Waymarks Among the Clouds
quest.skyabyss.weekly_back_trials.summar: Clear three trials on the stone whale's back. Party members with you count too.
quest.skyabyss.weekly_back_trials.title: Trials of the Back
quest.skyabyss.weekly_back_trials.trials: A note on the board: "Clear three of the trials on the whale's back. Once I hear you reached the glowing marks, that's enough. —The whale chaser"
Clear a trial on the stone whale's back (reach the glowing mark)
quest.skyabyss.weekly_back_trials.unlock: Available once you have reached the stone whale's back
quest.skyabyss.weekly_heart_again.done: The beating has stopped. But it will start again, surely.
A note in the corner of the board: "A stilled heartbeat starts again. Go and make sure of it, once every seven days."
It is unsigned.
quest.skyabyss.weekly_heart_again.summar: Still the stone whale's heart once more. Party members in the fight count too.
quest.skyabyss.weekly_heart_again.title: The Heart, Once More

quest.skyabyss.weekly_route.summary: Take a route from a titan shrine and cross it to the heart. Any titan will do.
quest.skyabyss.weekly_route.done: The heart stilled at the end of the route.
quest.skyabyss.weekly_route.route.journa: A note on the board: "Answer a shrine's song and cross a back once more. — the Whale Chaser"
quest.skyabyss.weekly_route.route.route: Cross a route to the heart
